decision.title: Trees: interface, node numbering, document order

body.p: (task 0.7). sxml_tree wraps an implementation (state + sxml_tree_operations) with a tree identifier and a reference count; the built-in sxml_arena_tree is one implementation and hosts can supply others. Contract for every implementation: node indices are in document order (preorder, attributes right after their element), so document order in a tree is an integer comparison, descendants are an index range (), and attributes are the indices after their element. Namespace nodes are not stored: a namespace node is (element index, namespace number from 1) into the element's in-scope namespaces, which keeps lexicographic order correct (XDM 4.0, section 6.2). Across trees, order is by tree identifier, issued in increasing order by the item heap to XTrees and JTrees alike, so it is stable and consistent (XDM 4.0, section 6.2). An sxml_node_reference is tree pointer + node index + namespace number and does not retain; node items do. When the count drops to zero the tree's owner is told (evaluation-built arena trees destroy themselves; host trees are destroyed by the host). Axes, XPath 4.0's -or-self axes included, are iterated by the library over the interface.
